item.title: Memory and dreaming: how Devin learns from working with you
item.description: Memory lets Devin carry useful learnings about the way you like to work across sessions. Dreaming is a daily asynchronous process that improves the index of Devin's memories about you.

item.title: GPT-6.1 Sol is now available in Devin
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol. It is live now in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI. Same $2/$10 list price as GPT-6 Sol, but cache reads are now 95% off, and on FrontierCode 1.1 it matches GPT-6 Sol's score at roughly half the cost per task at every reasoning effort. At low effort it scores 58.1% for $0.21 per task, the best score of any model under $0.30.

item.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
item.description: You can now sign in to Devin with ChatGPT and use your eligible ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan for OpenAI model usage across Devin Cloud, Devin Desktop, and Devin CLI.

item.title: Cognition and MongoDB partner to modernize enterprise infrastructure in months, not years
item.description: Cognition and MongoDB are bringing Devin into MongoDB’s Application Modernization Platform (AMP) to help customers migrate legacy applications to MongoDB Atlas.

item.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is now available in Devin
item.description: On FrontierCode 1.1, Sonnet 5.5 is a significant improvement from Sonnet 5 at 64.4%, surpassing even Fable 5.1 at extra high reasoning effort.

item.title: Devin is now up to 40% more cost-efficient
item.description: Devin is now 30-40% cheaper in Fusion and Normal mode, 15-20% cheaper in Ultra, and up to 70% cheaper in Devin Review, thanks to the latest models and a more efficient harness.

item.title: Devin now works across Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365
item.description: Native support to @ mention Devin in Microsoft Teams, plus a first-party Microsoft 365 integration that connects Devin to mail, calendar, files, tasks, chats, and your directory.

item.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now available in Devin
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. Both are live now in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI. On FrontierCode 1.1, Sol matches GPT-5.6 Sol at 61% lower cost per task, and Luna beats GPT-5.6 Luna at a quarter of the cost, making it the cheapest model on the leaderboard.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in Devin
item.description: Claude Opus 5.5 is now live in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI. It is the new #1 on FrontierCode 1.1, edging out Fable 5 and GPT-6 Astra at less than a tenth of the cost of Fable 5.

item.title: Grok 4.7 is now available in Devin
item.description: Grok 4.7 is now live in Devin Desktop and the Devin CLI. On FrontierCode 1.1 it is strongest on hard, multi-module backend tasks, and trails Grok 4.6 on the aggregate because it tends to over-scope.

item.title: Bringing Devin Cloud to your terminal
item.description: Starting today, you can create, steer, resume, and watch your Devin Cloud sessions right from your favorite terminal. Just use devin --cloud or /cloud.

item.title: Introducing Code Scans
item.description: Code Scans turns broad engineering goals into concrete improvements across your codebase. Tell Devin what you want to achieve, and it investigates what needs to change, evaluates the findings, and turns them into pull requests.

item.title: Bringing macOS to Devin
item.description: Today, we're launching macOS support for Devin, extending Devin's autonomous cloud development workflows to iOS apps, native macOS applications, and any project that depends on Apple's development tools.
